name: sns
description: Amazon Simple Notification Service Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) is a web service that enables you to build distributed web-enabled applications.

subcommands.name: add-permission
subcommands.description: Adds a statement to a topic's access control policy, granting access for the specified Amazon Web Services accounts to the specified actions.

subcommands.name: check-if-phone-number-is-opted-out
subcommands.description: Accepts a phone number and indicates whether the phone holder has opted out of receiving SMS messages from your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: confirm-subscription
subcommands.description: Verifies an endpoint owner's intent to receive messages by validating the token sent to the endpoint by an earlier Subscribe action.

subcommands.name: create-platform-application
subcommands.description: Creates a platform application object for one of the supported push notification services, such as APNS and GCM (Firebase Cloud Messaging), to which devices and mobile apps may register.

subcommands.name: create-platform-endpoint
subcommands.description: Creates an endpoint for a device and mobile app on one of the supported push notification services, such as GCM (Firebase Cloud Messaging) and APNS.

subcommands.name: create-sms-sandbox-phone-number
subcommands.description: Adds a destination phone number to an Amazon Web Services account in the SMS sandbox and sends a one-time password (OTP) to that phone number.

subcommands.name: create-topic
subcommands.description: Creates a topic to which notifications can be published.

subcommands.name: delete-endpoint
subcommands.description: Deletes the endpoint for a device and mobile app from Amazon SNS.

subcommands.name: delete-platform-application
subcommands.description: Deletes a platform application object for one of the supported push notification services, such as APNS and GCM (Firebase Cloud Messaging).

subcommands.name: delete-sms-sandbox-phone-number
subcommands.description: Deletes an Amazon Web Services account's verified or pending phone number from the SMS sandbox.

subcommands.name: delete-topic
subcommands.description: Deletes a topic and all its subscriptions.

subcommands.name: get-data-protection-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves the specified inline DataProtectionPolicy document that is stored in the specified Amazon SNS topic.

subcommands.name: get-endpoint-attributes
subcommands.description: Retrieves the endpoint attributes for a device on one of the supported push notification services, such as GCM (Firebase Cloud Messaging) and APNS.

subcommands.name: get-platform-application-attributes
subcommands.description: Retrieves the attributes of the platform application object for the supported push notification services, such as APNS and GCM (Firebase Cloud Messaging).

subcommands.name: get-sms-attributes
subcommands.description: Returns the settings for sending SMS messages from your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: get-sms-sandbox-account-status
subcommands.description: Retrieves the SMS sandbox status for the calling Amazon Web Services account in the target Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: get-subscription-attributes
subcommands.description: Returns all of the properties of a subscription.

subcommands.name: get-topic-attributes
subcommands.description: Returns all of the properties of a topic.

subcommands.name: list-endpoints-by-platform-application
subcommands.description: Lists the endpoints and endpoint attributes for devices in a supported push notification service, such as GCM (Firebase Cloud Messaging) and APNS.

subcommands.name: list-origination-numbers
subcommands.description: Lists the calling Amazon Web Services account's dedicated origination numbers and their metadata.

subcommands.name: list-phone-numbers-opted-out
subcommands.description: Returns a list of phone numbers that are opted out, meaning you cannot send SMS messages to them.

subcommands.name: list-platform-applications
subcommands.description: Lists the platform application objects for the supported push notification services, such as APNS and GCM (Firebase Cloud Messaging).

subcommands.name: list-sms-sandbox-phone-numbers
subcommands.description: Lists the calling Amazon Web Services account's current verified and pending destination phone numbers in the SMS sandbox.

subcommands.name: list-subscriptions
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the requester's subscriptions.

subcommands.name: list-subscriptions-by-topic
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the subscriptions to a specific topic.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: List all tags added to the specified Amazon SNS topic.

subcommands.name: list-topics
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the requester's topics.

subcommands.name: opt-in-phone-number
subcommands.description: Use this request to opt in a phone number that is opted out, which enables you to resume sending SMS messages to the number.

subcommands.name: publish
subcommands.description: Sends a message to an Amazon SNS topic, a text message (SMS message) directly to a phone number, or a message to a mobile platform endpoint (when you specify the TargetArn).

subcommands.name: publish-batch
subcommands.description: Publishes up to 10 messages to the specified topic in a single batch.

subcommands.name: put-data-protection-policy
subcommands.description: Adds or updates an inline policy document that is stored in the specified Amazon SNS topic.

subcommands.name: remove-permission
subcommands.description: Removes a statement from a topic's access control policy.

subcommands.name: set-endpoint-attributes
subcommands.description: Sets the attributes for an endpoint for a device on one of the supported push notification services, such as GCM (Firebase Cloud Messaging) and APNS.

subcommands.name: set-platform-application-attributes
subcommands.description: Sets the attributes of the platform application object for the supported push notification services, such as APNS and GCM (Firebase Cloud Messaging).

subcommands.name: set-sms-attributes
subcommands.description: Use this request to set the default settings for sending SMS messages and receiving daily SMS usage reports.

subcommands.name: set-subscription-attributes
subcommands.description: Allows a subscription owner to set an attribute of the subscription to a new value.

subcommands.name: set-topic-attributes
subcommands.description: Allows a topic owner to set an attribute of the topic to a new value.

subcommands.name: subscribe
subcommands.description: Subscribes an endpoint to an Amazon SNS topic.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Add tags to the specified Amazon SNS topic.

subcommands.name: unsubscribe
subcommands.description: Deletes a subscription.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Remove tags from the specified Amazon SNS topic.

subcommands.name: verify-sms-sandbox-phone-number
subcommands.description: Verifies a destination phone number with a one-time password (OTP) for the calling Amazon Web Services account.
